[SWS_DM_00902] NumberOfStoredEntries
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04109
⌈
If the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::GetNumberOfStoredEntries
is called, the DM shall return the number of event memory entries (DTCs) currently
stored in this
event memory
. An update notification shall be sent to the function regis-
tered via
ara::diag::DTCInformation::SetNumberOfStoredEntriesNoti-
fier
whenever the value of NumberOfStoredEntries has changed.
⌋
